snippet.title: How I Made A Steam Game In Only 1 Month
snippet.description:
🎮 Play Gun Frog Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173130/Gun_Frog/ 🎮

The development cycle of Gun Frog has been short but exciting. Let me know what you think of Gun Frog in the comments or by leaving a Steam review!
